department: Department of Employment and Training, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: You get a small amount every month while you look for a job. Rs 200 if you failed SSLC, Rs 300 if you passed SSLC, Rs 400 if you passed HSC, Rs 600 if you are a graduate. You get it for 3 years. If you have a disability, you get Rs 600 (SSLC and below), Rs 750 (HSC) or Rs 1,000 (graduate) for 10 years.

other: You must be registered at the District Employment and Career Guidance Centre for 5 years or more (1 year or more if you have a disability).
The age limit is 40 years. It is 45 years for SC/ST.
You must have studied in Tamil Nadu, or your parents must have lived in Tamil Nadu for at least 15 years.
You must not have a job or run your own business.
You must not be a regular student in a school or college.
Professional degree holders cannot get it.
You need a savings account in a nationalised bank in your district.

documents: Consolidated certificate from the Revenue Department (family income, no job, studied in Tamil Nadu)
If you have a disability: National Identity Card for persons with disabilities
how_to_apply: Register at your District Employment and Career Guidance Centre. After 5 years of registration, fill the application form. Give your bank details and the Revenue Department certificate with it.
where_to_apply: District Employment and Career Guidance Centre (DECGC) in your district
